issues.title: TargetFramework requires update from net6.0 to net8.0
issues.description: The project file specifies TargetFramework as net6.0, which must be updated to net8.0 to compile and run on .NET 8 runtime. This is a mandatory change for .NET 8 migration.
issues.impact: Updated project to target .NET 8 runtime, enabling compilation and execution on .NET 8
issues.remediation: Changed TargetFramework element from net6.0 to net8.0 in the project file

issues.title: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer requires upgrade to 8.0.x
issues.description: The Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer package is currently at version 6.0.25. For .NET 8 compatibility and to receive security updates, this should be upgraded to version 8.0.x.
issues.impact: Updated JWT Bearer authentication to latest stable version for .NET 8 with security patches

issues.title: Entity Framework Core packages require upgrade to 8.0.x
issues.description: Multiple Entity Framework Core packages (Design, InMemory, SqlServer) are at version 6.0.25 and need to be upgraded to 8.0.x for .NET 8 compatibility. EF Core 8 includes performance improvements and new features.
issues.originalCode: Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design, InMemory, SqlServer all at Version 6.0.25
issues.fixedCode: Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design, InMemory, SqlServer all upgraded to Version 8.0.11
issues.impact: Updated all Entity Framework Core packages to version 8.0.11 for .NET 8 compatibility and performance improvements
issues.remediation: Upgraded Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.InMemory, and Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer from 6.0.25 to 8.0.11

issues.title: Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Console requires upgrade to 8.0.x
issues.description: The Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Console package is at version 6.0.0 and should be upgraded to 8.0.x for consistency with .NET 8 and to receive performance improvements.
issues.impact: Updated logging console package to version 8.0.1 for .NET 8 performance improvements

issues.title: Swashbuckle.AspNetCore should be updated for .NET 8 support
issues.description: Swashbuckle.AspNetCore version 6.4.0 should be updated to 6.5.0 or later for better .NET 8 support and compatibility with OpenAPI 3.1.
issues.impact: Updated Swashbuckle for improved .NET 8 support and OpenAPI 3.1 compatibility

issues.title: System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt has security vulnerability and dependency conflict
issues.description: System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt version 6.25.1 has a known moderate severity vulnerability (GHSA-59j7-ghrg-fj52) and causes a package downgrade conflict with Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer 8.0.11 which requires version 7.1.2 or higher.
issues.impact: Resolved security vulnerability and dependency conflict by upgrading to version 8.2.1
issues.remediation: Upgraded package version from 6.25.1 to 8.2.1 to fix CVE and resolve transitive dependency conflict

recommendations: Perform comprehensive testing of JWT authentication and authorization flows
Test all database operations with Entity Framework Core 8 to verify query behavior
Review API endpoint functionality and ensure all controllers work correctly
Test Swagger/OpenAPI documentation generation with updated Swashbuckle
Consider enabling RequireHttpsMetadata=true in production for enhanced security
Review CORS policy (currently allows all origins) and tighten for production
Consider implementing token refresh mechanisms for JWT authentication
Add rate limiting for authentication endpoints using .NET 8 middleware
Leverage .NET 8 performance improvements like enhanced JSON serialization
Run full integration test suite to verify all functionality after upgrade
